about: ZONE-GUIDE (decision 0043): AshLight's own per-zone guide, keyed by act key and zone name as the log names it. Facts from public sources (research 0034), never their wording; unsure facts are left out. Reloads by itself when saved.

G1.default: Act 1: push north through the woods to Ogham Manor and its count.

The Riverbank.objective: Beat the swollen miller boss at the far end of the river.
The Riverbank.layout: First zone: grab a weapon, follow the river and beat the boss at its end.

optional.text: Uncut skill gem - in a chest partway along the river.

Clearfell Encampment.objective: Town: talk to Renly for a gem, sell, then head into Clearfell.
Clearfell Encampment.layout: Town: sell junk, check the vendors for a better weapon, then head out.

Clearfell.objective: Find the Grelwood exit; the Mud Burrow cave is a short detour.
Clearfell.layout: The Mud Burrow entrance tends to sit near the waypoint.

optional.text: +10% cold resistance - beat Beira at a ritual site near the middle.
Uncut skill gem - in an abandoned campsite stash.

Mud Burrow.objective: Beat the Devourer at the bottom, then report back to Renly.
Mud Burrow.layout: Short cave with a boss at the bottom; worth it early for the experience.

optional.text: Uncut skill gem - from the Devourer; Renly adds a support gem.

The Grelwood.objective: Hub: take the runes from the Red Vale to the Tree of Souls here.
The Grelwood.layout: Big forest hub: several paths branch off here; take the main road first.

optional.text: Flasks and an uncut support gem - from a witch's hut cauldron.

The Red Vale.objective: Activate three rust obelisks, survive each wave, then beat the Rust King.
The Red Vale.layout: Optional side zone: a tougher fight with a reward; skip it if you are rushing.

The Grim Tangle.objective: Pass through to the Cemetery of the Eternals.
The Grim Tangle.layout: Dense, dark thicket: move steadily and look for the way down to the cemetery.

optional.text: Uncut support gem - beat the Rotten Druid, an optional boss.

Cemetery of the Eternals.objective: Clear both tombs, open the memorial gate and beat Lachlann.
Cemetery of the Eternals.layout: Hub for two tombs: both side zones hold what you need to go on.

optional.text: A random ring - from a grave at the zone edge.

Mausoleum of the Praetor.objective: Beat Draven, the Eternal Praetor, at the end.
Mausoleum of the Praetor.layout: Side tomb: clear to the end for the item that opens the way on.

Tomb of the Consort.objective: Beat Asinia, the Praetor's Consort, at the end.
Tomb of the Consort.layout: Side tomb: clear to the end for the second item that opens the way on.

Hunting Grounds.objective: Head on to Ogham Farmlands; Freythorn is a worthwhile side trip.
Hunting Grounds.layout: Points of interest tend to sit near the corners.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - beat the Crowbell in a gated pit arena.

Freythorn.objective: Optional: light the three small ritual altars, then the big one.
Freythorn.layout: Optional side zone with a ritual fight; the reward is worth the detour.

optional.text: +30 spirit - beat the King in the Mists at the big altar.

Ogham Farmlands.objective: Push through the farms to Ogham Village.
Ogham Farmlands.layout: Farms before the village: look around for a quest item along the way.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - bring Una's lute, found in a hut, back to Una.

Ogham Village.objective: Beat the Executioner and free Leitis; grab Renly's tools.
Ogham Village.layout: Burning village: push through to the manor gates.

The Manor Ramparts.objective: Climb the walls to the manor door; no boss here.
The Manor Ramparts.layout: Walls of the manor: clear the ramparts to reach the door.

optional.text: Uncut support gem - cut down the hanged man at the gallows.

Ogham Manor.objective: Act boss: Count Geonor on the top floor.
Ogham Manor.layout: Act boss inside: check resistances and flasks before you go in.

optional.text: +20 maximum life - beat Candlemass on the first floor.

G2.default: Act 2: travel by caravan; the map marks the next quest zone.

Vastiri Outskirts.objective: Beat Rathbreaker and reach the caravan.
Vastiri Outskirts.layout: Desert edge: follow the road to the caravan.

The Ardura Caravan.objective: Town: use the desert map to travel; follow the quest marker.
The Ardura Caravan.layout: Moving town: vendors and travel to the next zone are here.

Mawdun Quarry.objective: Fight down to the mine entrance.
Mawdun Quarry.layout: Quarry: fight down toward the mine.

Mawdun Mine.layout: Mine with a boss at the end; it unlocks the way forward.

The Halani Gates.objective: First visit: face Jamanra. Later: sound the horn to open the gates.
The Halani Gates.layout: Gate fight: clear the way through to continue the act.

optional.text: Uncut skill gem - beat L'im, an optional boss.

Traitor's Passage.objective: Open the ancient seal and beat Balbala.
Traitor's Passage.layout: Cave passage with a boss; it opens the way deeper into the desert.

Trial of the Sekhemas.objective: Clear the trial and beat Rattlecage for your ascendancy.

Keth.objective: Cross the city to the Lost City.
Keth.layout: The exit tends to be across a large bridge, opposite the entrance.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - beat Kabala, the Constrictor Queen, in a central pit.

The Lost City.objective: Find the way down to the Buried Shrines.
The Lost City.layout: Underground ruins: push through to the shrines.

Buried Shrines.objective: Beat Azarian and bring the cinders to the water goddess.
Buried Shrines.layout: Shrine boss at the end; take your time with its attacks.

optional.text: A resistance ring - from an elemental offering before the boss.

Mastodon Badlands.objective: Find the way into the Bone Pits.
Mastodon Badlands.layout: Open badlands: find the way down into the Bone Pits.

The Bone Pits.objective: Beat the two pit bosses; a sun clan relic drops here.
The Bone Pits.layout: Pit boss at the bottom; its drop moves the act on.

Valley of the Titans.objective: Touch the three ancient seals to open the Titan Grotto.
Valley of the Titans.layout: Large valley: look for the item that opens the way to the grotto.

optional.text: A charm bonus of your choice - set both clan relics on the altar near the waypoint.

The Titan Grotto.layout: Cave with a boss; check your life flask before the fight.

Deshar.objective: Clear on to the Path of Mourning.
Deshar.layout: Ruined city on the way to the spires; clear forward.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - take a fallen soldier's last letter to Shambrin.

Path of Mourning.layout: Long climb: keep moving toward the spires.

The Spires of Deshar.objective: Beat Tor Gul at the top.
The Spires of Deshar.layout: High spires: clear to the top to move the act on.

optional.text: +10% lightning resistance - pray at the sisters' shrine.

The Dreadnought's Wake.objective: Follow the war machine's trail to it.
The Dreadnought's Wake.layout: The trail of the great war machine: clear through to it.

Dreadnought.objective: Act boss: Jamanra. Cap your resistances first.
Dreadnought.layout: Act boss aboard the war machine: cap your resistances and refill flasks first.

G3.default: Act 3: jungle and Vaal ruins; clear toward Utzaal and the act boss.

Sandswept Marsh.objective: Walk on to the Ziggurat Encampment.
Sandswept Marsh.layout: Marsh path: follow it to the next camp.

optional.text: Uncut skill gem - beat Rootdredge, an optional boss.

Ziggurat Encampment.objective: Town: head out to the Jungle Ruins.
Ziggurat Encampment.layout: The jungle exit tends to be near the top of town.

Jungle Ruins.objective: Hub: the Venom Crypts and the Infested Barrens start here.
Jungle Ruins.layout: The Venom Crypts entrance tends to be by the waypoint.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - beat Mighty Silverfist, an optional boss.

The Venom Crypts.layout: Poison crypt: chaos resistance helps; look for the quest item.

optional.text: A permanent bonus of your choice - bring the venom vial to Servi.

Infested Barrens.objective: Take the outer exit to the Chimeral Wetlands.
Infested Barrens.layout: Barren ground: clear forward toward the waterways.

Chimeral Wetlands.objective: Beat Xyclucian at the Machinarium entrance.
Chimeral Wetlands.layout: Wetlands with a boss; it opens the way to the temple.

Jiquani's Machinarium.objective: Carry soul cores through to the Sanctum.
Jiquani's Machinarium.layout: Old machine halls: power the way through to the sanctum.

optional.text: +10% fire resistance - beat Blackjaw behind a two-core door.

Jiquani's Sanctum.objective: Power the generators, beat Zicoatl and take the large soul core.
Jiquani's Sanctum.layout: Sanctum with a fight at the end; it moves the act on.

The Matlan Waterways.objective: Work the levers to drain the water; the last lever opens the city.
The Matlan Waterways.layout: Waterways: open the flow to reach the drowned city.

The Azak Bog.layout: Optional bog with a ritual fight; the reward is worth the detour.

optional.text: +30 spirit - beat Ignagduk, the bog witch.

The Drowned City.objective: Two exits: Apex of Filth is the main path.
The Drowned City.layout: Sunken city: clear through toward the vault.

The Molten Vault.layout: Hot vault: watch fire damage, then push to the end.

optional.text: Uncut skill gem and a reforging bench - beat Mektul in a timed fight.

Apex of Filth.objective: Beat the Queen of Filth in the centre.
Apex of Filth.layout: Boss at the top of the filth: take it slowly.

Temple of Kopec.objective: Climb the temple and beat Ketzuli.
Temple of Kopec.layout: Stairs tend to be in the corners of the triangle.

The Trial of Chaos.objective: Optional: do the trial any time for ascendancy points.

Utzaal.layout: The old city: clear through toward Aggorat.

Aggorat.objective: Push through to the Black Chambers.
Aggorat.layout: City heart: push on to the black chambers.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - sacrifice a Vaal heart at the altar.

The Black Chambers.layout: Act boss below: cap resistances and refill flasks before you go.

G4.default: Act 4: sail from Kingsmarch to the islands in any order.

Kingsmarch.objective: Town: sail from the dock to the next island.
Kingsmarch.layout: Port town: vendors and the ship to the islands.

Isle of Kin.objective: Fight on to the Volcanic Warrens.
Isle of Kin.layout: First island: clear it and look for the cave inside.

Volcanic Warrens.objective: Beat Krutog in the throne room.
Volcanic Warrens.layout: Volcanic caves: watch fire damage on the way through.

Kedge Bay.layout: Bay island: clear it and move on.

Journey's End.objective: Beat Captain Hartlin, then use the spikes to clear the dark mists.
Journey's End.layout: Island with a fight at its end; it moves the act on.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - beat Omniphobia in the dark mists.

Whakapanu Island.objective: Head on to the Singing Caverns.
Whakapanu Island.layout: Island with caves; clear through to the inner cave.

optional.text: A defence bonus of your choice - bring the great white's fin to Kaimana.

Singing Caverns.layout: Cave with a boss at the end.

Shrike Island.objective: Beat the Scourge of the Skies for a torn map piece.
Shrike Island.layout: Bird island: clear it and look for its fight.

Abandoned Prison.layout: Prison island: clear down toward the cells.

optional.text: A flask recovery bonus of your choice - from the goddess of justice.

Solitary Confinement.layout: Prison depths with a boss; check flasks first.

Eye of Hinekora.objective: Head on to the Halls of the Dead.
Eye of Hinekora.layout: Sacred island: follow the path inward.

optional.text: +5% maximum mana - in the silent hall past a checkpoint near the end.

Halls of the Dead.objective: Do the three tattoo trials; the way on is at the far end.
Halls of the Dead.layout: Halls with trials; take them one at a time.

optional.text: Three permanent bonuses of your choice - one per tattoo trial.

Trial of the Ancestors.objective: Beat Yama the White, then speak to Hinekora.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - for finishing the trial.

Arastas.layout: Ruins on the way to the end of the act; clear forward.

The Excavation.layout: Dig site: push down to its end.

Ngakanu.objective: Push on to the Heart of the Tribe.

Plunder's Point.objective: Optional: opens once you hold four torn map pieces.

P1.default: Interlude 1: from the Refuge to Holten Estate.

The Refuge.objective: Town: leave for the Scorched Farmlands.

Stones of Serle.objective: Optional: wake six megaliths on the edge, then face Siora in the centre.

The Blackwood.objective: Find the hidden way into Holten.

Holten.objective: Free the ferryman's soul in the centre.
Holten.layout: The side path to Wolvenhold starts in this zone.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - beat Oswin, the Dread Warden, for his ledger.

Holten Estate.objective: Final fight: Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth.

P2.default: Interlude 2: from the Khari Bazaar to Qimah Reservoir.

The Khari Bazaar.objective: Town: any exit leads to the Khari Crossing.

The Khari Crossing.objective: Head on to the Pools of Khatal.

optional.text: +5% maximum life - at the molten shrine up the north stairway.
A book of 2 skill points - beat the two bosses in the east arena, then see Risu.

Pools of Khatal.objective: No boss: go on to the sanctuary.

Qimah.objective: Cross the city to the reservoir.

optional.text: A permanent bonus of your choice - at a pillar down a narrow passage on the outer wall.

Qimah Reservoir.objective: Final fight: Azmadi, the Faridun Prince.

P3.default: Interlude 3: from the Glade up to the Cuachic Vault.

The Glade.objective: Town: leave for the Ashen Forest.

Kriar Village.objective: Head on to the Glacial Tarn.

optional.text: +40 spirit - beat Lythara, the Wayward Spear.

Glacial Tarn.layout: The side path to the Howling Caves starts in this zone.

optional.text: A book of 2 skill points - bring the yeti's tusks to Hilda.

Kriar Peaks.objective: Climb on to the Etched Ravine.

optional.text: A free unique item - follow the spirits to an elder on a cliff top.

endgame.objective: Kill the map boss to complete the map; the other rares are optional.
endgame.layout: Layouts are random: read the map's mods before you go in.
